title: Units, prefixes and decibels
blurb: The big idea before the cards.

lines.caption: Radio numbers run from tiny to huge. A prefix in front of the unit keeps them short.
lines.label: metric prefixes

lines.caption: Kilo means a thousand and mega means a million. Milli means a thousandth and micro means a millionth.
lines.label: big and small

lines.caption: Changing the prefix only moves the decimal point. 1.5 amperes is the same as 1500 milliamperes.
lines.say: Changing the prefix only moves the decimal point. One and a half amperes is the same as fifteen hundred milliamperes.
lines.label: same amount, new unit

lines.caption: Frequencies work the same way. 1,500,000 hertz is 1500 kilohertz.
lines.say: Frequencies work the same way. One and a half million hertz is fifteen hundred kilohertz.
lines.label: three places at a time

lines.caption: Decibels compare two powers. Twice the power is 3 decibels. Ten times the power is 10 decibels.
lines.label: decibels
